faces.name: Ensign Harry Kim, Operations
faces.oracleText:
Whenever another creature you control enters, if it has greater power than Ensign Kim, put a +1/+1 counter on Ensign Kim.
{2}, Remove two +1/+1 counters from among creatures you control: Draw a card.

faces.name: Ensign Pavel Chekov
faces.oracleText: Strange new worlds — When Ensign Chekov enters, each opponent exiles the top X cards of their library, where X is the number of differently named lands you control. For each opponent, choose a land card that player owns exiled this way. You may play the chosen cards for as long as they remain exiled.
